c01s03.title: Two different claims
c01s03.caption: A neural association does not automatically establish a causal mechanism.

c01s03b.title: Complementary measurements
c01s03b.caption: Different measures offer different kinds of resolution.

c01s04.title: Evaluate the image claim
c01s04.caption: A colourful image is a measurement, not a complete mental-state label.

c01s05.title: A brain claim needs three checks
c01s05.caption: Method limits qualify the claim rather than invalidate neuroscience.

c02s03.title: A simplified neuron
c02s03.caption: The diagram simplifies a diverse class of cells.

c02s03b.title: A propagated event
c02s03b.caption: A simplified action-potential sequence is not a psychological codebook.

c02s04.title: A chemical synapse
c02s04.caption: Receptor and circuit context determine the effect.

c02s05.title: Different levels of signalling
c02s05.caption: The two mechanisms are connected but distinct.

c03s03.title: Several contributions to a repair
c03s03.caption: The functions interact across connected systems.

c03s03b.title: A real distinction and an overreach
c03s03b.caption: Hemispheric specialization does not divide people into thinking types.

c03s04.title: Interpret a lesion finding
c03s04.caption: A lesion supports a bounded system-level inference.

c03s05.title: From region to system
c03s05.caption: Brain organization includes specialization and interaction.

c04s03.title: From event to response
c04s03.caption: Receiving a physical stimulus differs from understanding a message.

c04s03b.title: Detection needs conditions
c04s03b.caption: The example illustrates a change in task conditions, not measured hearing thresholds.

c04s04.title: Improve the actual message
c04s04.caption: Communication needs usable information rather than assumed reception.

c04s05.title: A sensory claim has levels
c04s05.caption: An everyday miss does not uniquely identify which level contributed.

c05s03.title: Useful simplification
c05s03.caption: Autonomic divisions interact rather than operate as a single on/off switch.

c05s03b.title: A simplified endocrine loop
c05s03b.caption: The same circulating signal can have different tissue-specific effects.

c05s04.title: One cue, several possibilities
c05s04.caption: A physiological cue does not uniquely identify an emotion.

c05s05.title: Interpret a body measure
c05s05.caption: A physiological signal needs a bounded interpretation.

c06s03.title: Distinguish the time course
c06s03.caption: Timing and context qualify claims about stress.

c06s03b.title: A simplified hormonal pathway
c06s03b.caption: This pathway is one component of a broader stress response.

c06s04.title: Respond at the relevant level
c06s04.caption: Stress is shaped by conditions as well as individual responses.

c06s05.title: Bound the stress inference
c06s05.caption: A stress explanation needs timescale, context and appropriate measures.

c07s03.title: Different processes
c07s03.caption: The processes interact; this is a conceptual model, not a personal sleep score.

c07s03b.title: Structure over the night
c07s03b.caption: A sleep-stage estimate depends on how it is measured.

c07s04.title: Read a sleep claim
c07s04.caption: A convenient estimate is not automatically a clinical assessment.

c07s05.title: A practical sleep question
c07s05.caption: Sleep is shaped by interacting processes and circumstances.

c08s03.title: Several levels between DNA and behaviour
c08s03.caption: A complex behaviour is not directly encoded as a single fixed instruction.

c08s03b.title: Population and individual
c08s03b.caption: A variance estimate does not divide an individual into genetic and environmental parts.

c08s04.title: Evaluate a genetic product
c08s04.caption: A marketed score needs evidence for its intended practical use.

c08s05.title: A genetic claim needs boundaries
c08s05.caption: Genetic influence does not imply a fixed individual outcome.

c09s03.title: A plasticity claim needs an outcome
c09s03.caption: Change alone does not demonstrate a benefit.

c09s03b.title: Two different benefit claims
c09s03b.caption: A local improvement does not establish a general cognitive upgrade.

c09s04.title: Match support to a goal
c09s04.caption: A broad brain claim is less useful than a tested functional outcome.

c09s05.title: Change and useful change
c09s05.caption: Plasticity is a mechanism category, not a universal endorsement.

c10s03.title: Link the explanation
c10s03.caption: A multilevel explanation tests links rather than merely listing levels.

c10s03b.title: Read beyond the biological label
c10s03b.caption: A plausible mechanism and an effective intervention are distinct claims.

c10s04.title: A responsible conclusion
items: A proportionate test or care route
c10s04.caption: Biological understanding should improve decisions without creating false certainty.

c10s05.title: A final biological check
c10s05.caption: Use neuroscience as evidence rather than a decorative authority.
